caption: A real table of role/permission pairs — a new role's access is an INSERT, not a policy rewrite.

eyebrow: CREATE ROW ACCESS POLICY and attaching it
code:
CREATE OR REPLACE ROW ACCESS POLICY governance.customer_city_row_policy
AS (city STRING) RETURNS BOOLEAN ->
  CURRENT_ROLE() IN ('ACCOUNTADMIN','SYSADMIN')
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT rp.role
    FROM governance.row_policy_map rp
    WHERE rp.role = CURRENT_ROLE()
      AND rp.city_permissions = city
  )
  COMMENT = 'Limits rows by mapping table of ROLE and CITY';

ALTER TABLE raw_customer.customer_loyalty
  ADD ROW ACCESS POLICY governance.customer_city_row_policy ON (city);
caption: TRUE means the row is visible; FALSE means it's silently filtered out — no error, it's just gone.
Every row: Tokyo only. Masking (Lessons 6-7) is still stacking independently on the same table.

eyebrow: The downstream view, grouped by city
caption: The view spans every city in the base table — but the restricted role only ever sees Tokyo.
